label_natural.decision: USDA Organic with named food ingredients and a named small farm where listed.
label_natural.delta: Natural has no general farming standard; on meat it means minimal processing and no artificial ingredients.

label_made_with_real.decision: USDA Organic with the named fruit or whole grain leading the ingredient list.
label_made_with_real.delta: Made with real promises presence, not a percentage; ingredient position alone never reveals the amount.

label_no_added_hormones.decision: USDA Organic meat or dairy with a pasture seal and a named farm.
label_no_added_hormones.delta: No added hormones describes hormone use, not feed or pasture; poultry and pork already prohibit growth hormones.

label_nonGMO_vs_organic.decision: USDA Organic first, with the Real Organic seal where available.
label_nonGMO_vs_organic.delta: Non-GMO verification checks genetic engineering, not organic farming; organic also sets growing and feed rules.

label_cage_free.decision: USDA Organic pasture-raised eggs with a Real Organic seal and a named small farm.
label_cage_free.delta: Cage-free means uncaged hens, not outdoor access; free-range adds outdoor access, not a soy-free feed promise.

label_grass_fed_term.decision: USDA Organic beef with an AGA seal, 100% grass-fed and grass-finished on the label.
label_grass_fed_term.delta: Grass-fed describes diet, not organic farming or an independent audit; the AGA seal verifies forage through finishing.

label_pasture_raised_feed.decision: USDA Organic pasture-raised eggs with a Real Organic seal and soy-free, corn-free feed.
label_pasture_raised_feed.delta: Pasture-raised describes outdoor rearing, not the full feed ration; organic feed can include soy and corn.

label_organic_scope.decision: 100% organic wording, a named small farm and the Real Organic seal where available.
label_organic_scope.delta: Organic is at least 95%, not 100%, and made with organic is at least 70%; both exclude water and salt.

label_multigrain_vs_whole_grain.decision: USDA Organic sprouted or sourdough bread with every grain ingredient listed as whole.
label_multigrain_vs_whole_grain.delta: Multigrain means several grains, not whole grains; 100% whole grain means all grain ingredients are whole.

label_lightly_sweetened.decision: USDA Organic unsweetened food with no sweetener in the ingredient list.
label_lightly_sweetened.delta: On cereal, lightly sweetened describes taste with no defined sugar limit; Added Sugars gives grams per serving.

label_no_artificial_flavors.decision: USDA Organic with fruit, herbs or spices named in ingredients, without added flavors.
label_no_artificial_flavors.delta: No artificial flavors still allows natural flavor mixtures; it promises neither whole fruit nor a flavor-free recipe.

label_front_vs_back.decision: USDA Organic with a short ingredient list of whole foods and a named small producer.
label_front_vs_back.delta: Front claims cover selected traits, not the whole recipe; ingredients can appear on the front or information panel.

label_ingredient_order.decision: USDA Organic with whole foods leading the list and every sweetener named.
label_ingredient_order.delta: Ingredients descend by weight, not exact percentage; a marked 2%-or-less section can list its ingredients in any order.

label_third_party_seals.decision: USDA Organic plus Real Organic for soil and pasture, or AGA for grass-fed livestock.
label_third_party_seals.delta: A third-party seal verifies its own standard, not every farming trait; a farm picture is no certification.

label_cold_pressed_expeller.decision: USDA Organic extra virgin olive oil or unrefined cold-pressed coconut oil.
label_cold_pressed_expeller.delta: Expeller means mechanical pressing, not cool processing; cold-pressed names low-heat extraction, not organic farming.

label_sugar_free_substitutes.decision: USDA Organic unsweetened food with no sugar substitutes in the ingredient list.
label_sugar_free_substitutes.delta: Sugar-free allows under half a gram per serving and reference amount; it can still contain sweeteners or sugar alcohols.

label_wild_vs_farm_raised.decision: Wild-caught fish with species, country and catch method on the tag or counter label.
label_wild_vs_farm_raised.delta: Wild means harvest from non-controlled waters, not necessarily wild-born; farm-raised means a controlled environment.

label_serving_size.decision: USDA Organic whole-food ingredients, with panel numbers compared at equal gram amounts.
label_serving_size.delta: Serving size is a usual eating amount, not a portion recommendation; a pack can contain multiple servings.

label_artificial_color.decision: USDA Organic food with no added coloring in the ingredient list.
label_artificial_color.delta: Artificial color means added color, not just synthetic dye; plant-derived coloring can use that wording too.

groups.title: Front claims and ingredient order
groups.why_same: Check the organic seal, then read the entire ingredient list and locate the named food and sweeteners by weight order.

groups.title: Egg housing and feed claims
groups.why_same: Check the organic and pasture seals, named farm, and separate soy-free and corn-free feed wording on the carton.
